title: SG-8.1 Rebuild the contribution sheet on the Radix dialog
summary: Contribution sheet uses a shadcn-style Radix dialog wrapper with focus trap, Escape, focus restoration and accessible title and description
description: Context: game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx renders a hand-made div with role=dialog, so it has no focus trap, no Escape handling and no focus restoration. @radix-ui/react-dialog is already a dependency but no wrapper exists under src/components/ui. Desired behavior: the sheet is built on the Radix dialog through a shadcn-style wrapper. Expected result: Tab stays inside the sheet, Escape closes it, focus returns to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger and the dialog exposes a title and description. Why: keyboard and screen-reader accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet is open, when the player presses Escape, then onClose is called
Given the sheet is open, when the player tabs past the last control, then focus stays inside the dialog
Given the sheet closes, when the dialog unmounts, then focus returns to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger
Given the sheet is open, then the dialog is labelled by a title and described by a description

out_of_scope: Changes to submission, quota or history logic
preserve: Existing labels Your idea, Send, Your suggestions

definition_of_done: All three requirements implemented and verified by unit tests
